title: One shared schema for every world record: the four fields each record must carry, and the date fields
description: Date fields are real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. related_pep_left_office_date may be an empty string, which means the related PEP is still in office; if the field is missing, that date is unknown. A leaving date may not be after the record's as_of_date. An evidence item is checked the same way: its value follows the rule of the field it names.
